instruction: Increase Chrome's default font size to 20 pixels for better readability.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Chrome's default font size to 20 pixels. The evaluator uses existing getter 'get_chrome_font_size' which reads webkit.webprefs.default_font_size from Preferences file. Uses existing metric 'check_font_size' which compares the actual font size with expected value. No new functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_chrome_font_size' correctly reads Chrome's default font size from webkit.webprefs.default_font_size in the Preferences file (chrome.py:424-462)

Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (default font size = 20 pixels). Single requirement, fully verified.
